title: Chumbe Island Coral Park
excerpt: Chumbe Island, off Zanzibar, is a private marine reserve with a protected coral reef and an eco-lodge. A model for conservation.
body:
Chumbe Island lies southwest of Stone Town. It is a privately managed nature reserve with a coral reef sanctuary and a forest reserve.

## The reef

The reef around Chumbe has been protected for decades and is known for healthy coral and many fish species. Snorkelling is guided.

## The forest

The island has a small forest with coconut crabs and birds.

## Eco-lodge

A small eco-lodge with bungalows that use rainwater and solar energy. Day visits are also possible.

## Education

The project runs environmental education programmes for local schools.

## Who it suits

Snorkellers, nature lovers and people interested in conservation.

Read our [Chumbe page](/islands/chumbe-island/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
